newsitem.title: USA: IRIDEX wins laser contract from U.S. Navy.
newsitem.headline: IRIDEX wins laser contract from U.S. Navy.

text.p: IRIDEX Corp said on Monday its Light Solutions Corp unit was awarded a contract from the U.S. Navy's Naval Research Laboratory to develop semiconductor-based high repetition rate infrared lasers.
The value of the contract award exceeded $500,000, the company said. It was awarded under the Small Business Innovation Research Program, IRIDEX said.

"By developing a compact, rugged, high-power semiconductor-based laser that is selectively tunable over the mid-infrared spectrum, we not only advance the technology, but we open up a wide variety of medical applications that can be served by IRIDEX," Larry Marshall, vice president of Light Solutions Corp, said.
The company said the technology would be applicable to its ophthalmic laser market.
